These eight unmodified FLAC excerpts and their transcripts come from the

listed in `transcripts.txt`. Reader: **Nolan Fout**. Work: *Ten Years Later*,
chapter “11 - Night”, LibriVox book 5863 / Project Gutenberg book 2681.

The Sparrow benchmark concatenates these excerpts with added silence and creates
labelled subtitle variants: unchanged, offset, rate drift, cut mismatch and
unrelated text. These are test transformations; no endorsement is implied.
